name: curio
description: Turn your own textbooks into an adaptive course on your Claude Code plan: a faithful reader, a grounded tutor, validated practice, a learner model, prerequisite maps, and spaced review.

library.title: Library folder
library.description: Where Curio keeps your courses, figures, and learner state. It stays on this computer.

ingest_model.title: Ingest model
ingest_model.description: Model for the agents that turn a PDF into a course. Structuring a whole book is a lot of output: sonnet balances quality and plan usage, opus is most faithful on dense math.

reader_window.title: Reader window
reader_window.description: How the reader opens: app (its own window with no tabs or address bar, when Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, or Vivaldi is installed) or browser (a tab in your default browser).
